source_scope.source_detail_limit: The prototype describes product-onboarding operations, review work and personnel administration, not one Catalog aggregate. Mutable latest-state tables, operator PII, opaque files, payroll and misspelled/mislabeled DDL require explicit splits and exclusions.

verification_policy.specified_definition: A product source is specified only when its detailed DDL proves the named asset and its grain, authority, identity, history, security, targets, corrections and runtime gate are explicit.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Verification requires a non-empty production bundle and full-denominator tenant-scoped zero-difference reconciliation under the governed evidence protocol.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Append product applications, workflow operations, review decisions and policy versions independently; never let a latest-result row replace operation history.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Source deletion retires mutable visibility but never erases accepted Catalog, Listing, review, quality or audit facts.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant, Principal, Merchant, supplier, SPU, category, brand, scene and source business keys before replay; quarantine unknown dictionaries, PII leaks, malformed files and cross-aggregate identity guesses.
